methods: using log to find leading digits
statement:
To nine decimal places, $\log_{10}2=0.301029996$ and $\log_{10}3=0.477121255$.

(i) Calculate $\log_{10}5$ and $\log_{10}6$ to three decimal places. By taking logs, or otherwise, show that
$$5\times10^{47}<3^{100}<6\times10^{47}.$$
Hence write down the first digit of $3^{100}$.

(ii) Find the first digit of each of the following numbers: $2^{1000}$; $2^{10000}$; and $2^{100000}$.
hints: Use log 5 = 1 - log 2 and log 6 = log 2 + log 3.
For a leading digit, look at the fractional part of the base-10 logarithm.
10^(fractional part) lies in [1,10), and its integer part is the leading digit.
